truth_evidence: Affected every release before 2.20.0; fixed in 2.20.0 (Authorization kept on an https -> http redirect to the same host).
Fix commit c45d7c4, the merge of PR #4718 'Strip Authorization header whenever root URL changes', in tag v2.20.0 and not in v2.19.1. https://github.com/psf/requests/pull/4718
rebuild_auth's hostname-only comparison is replaced by a call to the new should_strip_auth, which also compares scheme and port.
Entry points: resolve_redirects calls rebuild_auth on every redirect, so every request path leads to it; rebuild_auth is itself a public method of Session.
